preconditions: Both arms wait actual visible, nonzero scrolling, original viewport contains button, exposed and active; waits each<=original5000ms and capped by shared24s source budget. Never wait for nativeHit to become true. Actual window QScreen availableGeometry must contain entire fixed client+frame and button globalRect. If not, outcome prerequisite_unmet_screen_frame_or_button, Qt failure/nonzero and no page-defect attribution; do not reposition/resize target to pass.
hit_assertion: QWidget *hit=QApplication::widgetAt(center); const bool nativeHit=hit==apply||(hit&&apply->isAncestorOf(hit)); QVERIFY(nativeHit); one-shot before content grab. No deleted/expectedFail/skipped hit assertion.
click_endpoint: Only after original hit predicate passes: QTest::mouseClick(QWindow*,window-local mapped same center). Record QWidget/QWindow local/window/screen press+release positions and clicked_count=1. This is Qt window injection, not OS XTest/physical pointer/compositor proof; QCursor pos is observed without setting it. CN must create original unsupported warning and exact lastStatus. Warning dismissed by existing API solely for cleanup; ACK input is not tested here.
recorded: Actual QScreen geometry/availableGeometry/virtualGeometry/availableVirtualGeometry/DPR/DPI for all screens and selected window screen, widget/window/grab DPR; client/frame/global origin, button local/global/viewport rect and center, visibleRegion full rectangles/contains; QWidget/QWindow topLevelAt and childAt, cursor, mouse route, safe selected Qt/DISPLAY/WAYLAND env, monotonic phases, exact raw argv/exits.
capture: Original QWidget::grab only after lookup (or precondition refusal), unmodified PNG+size/DPR. It proves local content capture only; cannot prove physical screen visibility, lack of other-window occlusion or compositor presentation.
time_bound: One GUI child with25s parent deadline plus independently bounded TERM3s/KILL2s owned-PGID cleanup; observed owned interval>30s cannot pass. Source shares24s for both arms and caps original5s waits. Cleanup is not normal-close proof after timeout/failure.
classification: both_passed_this_once / screen_precondition_unmet_not_page_conclusion / control_not_passed_no_CN_specific_attribution / CN_not_passed_after_control_pass_no_automatic_root_cause / incomplete receipt. No automatic CN/WSLg/root-cause classification.
safety_scope: Only own two windows; no user-window tests, physical cursor moves, display config changes, devices/network/SQL/auth/production data. All source fixed except newprivate files; runtime/XDG/logs only new private child output.
